title: Camera RAW files in Library through the suite's shared RAW decode, and every photo developed in a wide float working space: embedded previews in the grid, full-size 16-bit export
covers: #427; feature map library/raw (new) and the library adopter of suiteui/shared-raw; RJ-L22
waits_on: import, thumbnails (built); export-pack LX-a (LibraryContracts.swift) before RW-2 and LX-m (LiveExporter.swift) before RW-3; cross-line: suiteui shared-codecs SC-f before RW-2 (the format registry: PhotoFileKind becomes SuiteImageFormat, with the camera RAW row), shared-raw SR-a before RW-1 and SR-m before RW-4, shared-codecs SC-library before RW-4 (ImageIODecoder.swift), shared-thumbnails ST-m and suite-imaging IM-library before RW-3 (LiveThumbnails, LiveLoupeImaging); metadata-more MD-3 and MD-7 now wait on RW-a and RW-m (re-cut 2026-10-21)
suiteui: suiteui/shared-raw (the decoder, refusals and test DNGs); no needs-ui issue
notes: Re-cut 2026-10-21 (captain: RAW in beta, shared) to Library's thin adoption of suiteui/shared-raw: no Library decoder, no RAW-only develop rows or catalog keys, no RAW+JPEG pairing or grid tag in the beta (open questions R1, R2). The float decode resolves D11 for RAW files.
quality: QB-LIB-1 for RAW (preview first), headroom (Exposure -1 keeps the highlight patches apart), QB-V4 for RAW, QB-F1; wide gamut and high bit depth (a P3 photo's out-of-sRGB red survives to a 16-bit TIFF)
library_title: Camera RAW files through the shared RAW decode

slices.behavior: `PhotoDecoding` offers a float decode with a default, the fake decoder answers RAW files from the shared fake, and a RAW file is the registry's camera RAW kind.
The grid asks for the embedded preview, the loupe for a draft then every pixel, export for every pixel, all as float, and the platform decoder scans, refuses and decodes RAW files through `SuiteRaw`.
On live services a folder with a RAW file imports, shows its preview, develops in the loupe and exports at full size, and the feature is built.
